name: Round bush
description: A round leafy shrub, wider than tall: a dense dome of clumped leaf cards on a few short woody stems hidden at the base, deep shadow green inside and underneath, olive in between and lit yellow-green on the top and outer rims. Variants are a medium bush, a small bush and a large, slightly lopsided bush of three merged lobes.

Painted look (match a painted isometric forest road): foliage is clumped leaf cards with value variation, never single flat planes and never one smooth blob.
